_notes: Andromeda (M31) over Alderan (1052) was attempted (ESA/Hubble heic2501a, CC BY 4.0) but DROPPED: the ultra-deep PHAST mosaic resolves Andromeda's own disk into individual stars across the faint halo and outer disc, indistinguishably mingled with foreground Milky Way stars, so reaching a zero-star look destroys the galaxy's resolved structure (the exact Sombrero failure the task warned about). See docs/reports/P592_GIANT_MILKY_WAY_TERRA.md.
